artworks.title: Flagellation of Christ, with the Pavement
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper (by Gian Marco Cavalli?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in an intense moment in an architectural setting with ornate columns. The figures are depicted with detailed human anatomy and positioned dynamically, some holding long rods or staffs. The background is shaded to enhance the depth of the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Francois Guenault
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person's body. The person is positioned facing slightly to the left, with their head turned towards the viewer. The subject appears middle-aged with a pronounced nose and friendly expression. They have long, curly hair reaching the shoulders. The individual is dressed in period attire with a white collar and a dark, textured garment. There are no visible accessories. The background is minimal and neutral, forming an oval frame around the bust, with inscriptions along the border.

artworks.title: Simon Dreux d'Aubray
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a distinctive mustache and goatee, long curly hair, and a direct gaze. He wears a collared garment with a large white collar, broad sleeves, and the image is set within an oval frame against an engraved background. Below the frame is a crest or coat of arms with decorative elements. The image has a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Antoine Barillon
artworks.description: This image features a man in a portrait. He is seated, looking straight at the viewer, with a neutral expression. The man has mid-length, wavy hair and a mustache and goatee. He wears a formal robe with a large, flat, white collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame and includes the man's coat of arms below. The background has detailed shading inside the oval and a plain area outside. The border of the oval contains inscriptions likely denoting the man's name and titles.

artworks.title: Christ in Limbo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a cross-staff emerging from a supernatural setting. The figure is draped in a robe and stands dominant over a chaotic scene, surrounded by individuals in distress or awe. The drawing features dramatic movement, strong contrasts, and intricate line work, creating a dynamic interaction between the figure and the surrounding creatures and people. The detailed rendering conveys triumph, conflict, and redemption.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The image features a central figure standing triumphantly with one hand raised and the other holding a staff topped with a cross and a banner. The figure is partially draped in cloth, and radiating lines surround their head. Emerging from a large rectangular structure resembling a stone box or tomb, the figure appears to be rising or resurrected. Surrounding the central figure are several reclining armored figures; some are startled or in various poses of waking. The composition is highly detailed, with precise line work defining the textures of cloth, armor, wood, and stone.

artworks.title: Giacomo Antonio Mannini
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is turned slightly to the right, with curly hair and detailed facial features including a prominent nose and slightly opened lips. Their expression appears contemplative. They are wearing a garment with a large, decorative collar featuring a swirling pattern, a buttoned-down front, and full sleeves. There is no visible jewelry. The background has a hatched pattern for texture, and the upper right corner shows the number "62" in small script.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man, depicting the upper half of his body from the shoulders upwards. The man is looking over his shoulder directly at the viewer. He has a mustache and wavy hair, and is wearing a cloak with intricate designs near the collar. The background is drawn in an oval shape within a rectangular frame, with cross-hatched shading for depth.

artworks.title: Tommaso Salini
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man with a bust-length portrait viewed slightly from the side. The man's body is turned to the left, with his head slightly forward, showing a profile view of his face. He has a prominent nose, full lips, and curly hair under a large brimmed hat. The man wears an intricately decorated garment with a collared shirt, a visible chain, and buttons. Beside the main portrait are two smaller faces - one inverted and one youthful - each with distinct features. The background is plain, with text including artistic attribution and the date, 1625.

artworks.title: Giovanni Baglione
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's bust. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a mustache that curls upward. His hair is short and slightly unkempt, and he has a pointed beard. He wears an intricately detailed garment with a large ruffled collar and decorative patterns. The garment shows detailed cross-hatching work and looks rich in texture. He wears a chain with a cross pendant. The background is plain, with no visible scenery or objects. The engraving is framed within an octagonal border, with text around the frame, presumably identifying the subject and the artist.

artworks.title: Giovanni Francesco Barbieri, called Guercino
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.7 x 11.4 cm (5 13/16 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body from around the chest up, in a slight three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. He has a mustache and short wavy hair. The man wears an ornate collar with lace detailing and a garment with decorative embroidery. The background is a simple, unadorned space that draws attention to the man. The border around him is an ornate frame made with straight lines, emphasizing the classical style of the artwork.

artworks.title: Gian Lorenzo Bernini
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man from the early 17th century. He is facing forward with a neutral expression, short wavy hair, a mustache, and defined facial features. He is depicted wearing a doublet with a lace collar, a chain with a cross pendant, and is framed by an octagonal border with a textured background. Latin text is present at the bottom of the image, likely identifying the person and the artist.

artworks.title: Paolo Giordano Orsini II
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man. He is depicted in a frontal position, slightly turned to the right. His facial features include a full face with curly hair styled into voluminous waves, a mustache with small curls at the ends, and a pointed, neatly groomed goatee. He wears a high, elaborate ruffled collar and richly patterned attire. The background is a simple ornamental oval frame with inscriptions around it.

artworks.title: Giuseppe Cesari
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned in a three-quarter view facing slightly to his right. He has a mustache and a small goatee, and his hair is medium length, wavy, and parted to the sides with a slightly receding hairline. His facial expression is neutral, with a calm gaze directed towards the viewer. The man is wearing a garment with a high collar adorned with intricate lace details. The garment is secured with buttons and appears textured. Around the man's neck, subtle hints of a cross pendant can be seen on his clothing. The background of the portrait is a plain, neutral area with an octagonal border framing the man's bust and additional decorative lettering surrounding the image, identifying him with text at the top and sides.

artworks.title: Giovanni Ciampoli, Papal Secretary
artworks.description: This print is a portrait of a man from the chest up within an oval frame. The man has a round, pale face with a small mustache and goatee. His face is slightly turned to the right, but he looks directly at us. His hair is dark, short, and combed back, with a prominent widow's peak in the center of his forehead. He wears a garment that appears to be made of thick, draped fabric or fur that is wrapped around his chest and shoulders, with a high collar peeking out around his neck. The background is plain, with small inscriptions at the corners on top of off-white paper.

artworks.title: Galileo Galilei
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man in an oval frame. He is centered and slightly turned to his left, with a serious expression. The man has distinct facial features including a high hairline, bushy eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a long beard, and a mustache. His hair is short and combed back. He is wearing a high-collared shirt under a dark, buttoned robe with draped sleeves. The background is plain with subtle shading, enhancing the three-dimensional effect of the portrait.

artworks.title: Giovanni Marino
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. He faces slightly left but looks directly at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features with a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, a prominent moustache, a pointed goatee, and loose wavy hair falling just above his shoulders. He wears a dark garment with an intricate lace collar, a cross pendant on a chain around his neck, and the portrait is framed within an oval border. The background is etched and textured, highlighting the subject within the oval. Decorative text is presented at the top for the subject's identity and artwork information around the borders.

artworks.title: Raffaelo Menicucci
artworks.description: This print is a portrait of a man's upper body. The man's body is slightly turned to the right, but he looks directly out at us. He has medium-toned skin, a long nose, a small mustache, a pointed goatee, and short, dark hair. He wears a large, dark, wide-brimmed hat, and wears a buttoned jacket with a tall collar. There also appears to be a sash or cloth draped from one shoulder down his chest and around his waist. The background is plain, beige paper. There are some lines of text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Pier Francesco Pauli
artworks.description: This print depicts the upper body of a man, showing his face and shoulders. He is positioned within an oval frame. The man has a full head of hair styled in waves and curls, framing his pale, slightly wrinkled face, alongside a mustache and a small patch of hair on his chin. He looks out at us with deep-set eyes. His attire consists of a patterned garment with large decorative buttons and a wide collar that curves over his shoulders. Outside of the oval border encasing the man's portrait, there is text in each corner of the image, including: "Eques Pier da Pesaro," "Francesco Pauli Secretario," "Eques Octauius Leonus," and "Roman' Pictor fecit."

artworks.title: Marcello Provenzale
artworks.description: This is a portrait illustration of a man's upper body. He is positioned slightly turned to the left but facing forward towards the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, including a large mustache and a small goatee. His hair is cropped short and slightly receding on the top. He is wearing a buttoned-up garment with an intricately patterned texture and a white lace collar around his neck. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands. The background consists of lined textures that accentuate the portrait within an octagonal border. Additionally, there is some text surrounding the portrait within the border.

artworks.title: Paolus Qualiatus Clodianus
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's head and shoulders, shown at an angle and facing the viewer. The man has facial hair, including a mustache and goatee, and thinning wavy hair. He wears a high-collared garment fastened with buttons. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame. The background is monochromatic without any additional elements.

artworks.title: Cristoforo Roncalli
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in intricate clothing, with an aged face, high forehead, defined cheekbones, light hair, and facial hair. He is wearing a high-collared garment and a cloak, with a medallion hanging around his neck. The background consists of engraved hatching within an octagonal border. Inscriptions above the man's head and in the lower corners identify him as "Eques Christophor Ronchalis de Pomeriis pictor" and credit the engraver as "Eques Octavius Leoni," dated "I Franck 1838."

artworks.title: Thomas Stilianus
artworks.description: The image shows a man portrayed from the chest up. He faces slightly to his left, with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The man features a large forehead, high hairline, prominent cheekbones, and a mustache with a small beard underneath. His hair is sparse at the top and more pronounced around the sides. He wears a formal outfit with a collared shirt under a garment with studs and a large button. A cross-like pendant hangs from his neck. The portrait is surrounded by a textured oval frame with inscriptions outside the oval.

artworks.title: Simon Vouet
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a pointed beard and mustache, wavy hair that falls to his collar, and a neutral expression. He is wearing period-appropriate attire with a high, frilled collar and a buttoned coat. The background is a shaded gradient within a rectangular frame with an octagonal outline. Text around the edges includes the name "Simon Vouet" and additional writings in Latin.
